title: White House AI timeline manipulator

tellings.quote: Talk about almost like a White House timeline manipulator, too.

plain: The idea is that something like an artificial intelligence able to steer events, "almost like a White House timeline manipulator," might be at work in the present decade. Michels raises it himself in passing, in a conversation with the filmmaker Jeremy Corbell, in connection with a man named Matthew Brown, and he does not spell out what the device would be or who would run it.
